text:
Grace Lin: FYI — we're adjusting promo-credit lifecycle and burst protection mechanics next billing cycle. This is a policy/UX update, not a price change. :megaphone:

Grace Lin: TL;DR:
- Promo-credit phasing: one-off promotional credits will phase out over 90 days instead of 30 by default; customers can opt-in to immediate expiration if needed.
- Burst protection cap: introduce a soft burst cap per account (tokens/minute) with an automatic fallback to surcharge-free soft-throttle for tiny spikes.
- Invoice transparency: invoices will include a new memo line 'credit_phase_policy' and a migration note for the first cycle.

Owen Blake: Rationale: some enterprise promos were expiring too quickly, causing customer support churn. Extending phase-out reduces surprise write-offs and matches marketing campaigns. Burst cap prevents large fanouts from draining promo pools.

Maya Singh: Rollout plan:
- Week 1: feature flag + UI preview showing phased expiry dates and proposed burst caps.
- Week 2: dry-run migration on opt-in cohort, no invoice changes.
- Week 4: default phase-out extended for all new promos; existing promos migrated with 90-day grace and invoice memo.

Tom Nguyen: Support KB quick answers:
- "Will my credits expire later?" -> Yes, new promos default to 90-day phase-out; existing credits keep current expiry for 30 days then migrate.
- "Will I be throttled?" -> Only if you repeatedly exceed the soft burst cap; small spikes are absorbed by the soft-throttle.

Grace Lin: API preview example to view promo expiry and burst cap: 

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/promos/preview?account=acct_ABC"
```

Owen Blake: Finance note: we'll add invoice memo 'credit_phase_policy' for the first 2 billing cycles during migration. No retroactive charges; if promo value accounting needs adjustments we'll coordinate with Legal.

billing-bot: Automated: feature_flag "billing.promo_phase_v2" created, owner=@owen, state=off, audit_id=bb-2475004321.

Maya Singh: Action items:
- @tom: KB + canned responses (ETA 48h)
- @owen: enable preview API and console card (ETA 72h)
- @finance: confirm invoice memo format & tax treatment (ETA 48h)
- @marketing: update promo terms & campaign copy (ETA 5 days)

Tom Nguyen: Adding support escalation path to Billing Eng for accounts impacted by burst cap during migration. Will post playbook in #support by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Grace Lin: Private/Dedicated: unchanged unless customer opts in. We'll expose a toggle for appliance customers.

Owen Blake: Telemetry requests: billing.promo.phase_migrated_count, billing.burstcap.fallback_events, billing.promo.writeoff_rate. @eng-infra please add.

Maya Singh: Customer comms: we'll email affected customers 72h before migration and show an in-console banner with details and opt-out link.

Grace Lin: Thanks team. If there are concerns about the timing DM me. Closing thread for now.
